parameters.help_en: The video description prompt. You must specify either this parameter or Media. For text-to-video generation, only Prompt is required
parameters.help_zh: 视频描述提示词。与 Media 必填其一（纯文生视频仅需 Prompt）
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The model name. Valid values: wan3.0-video (default) and wan3.0-video-prime (high-speed version)
parameters.help_zh: 模型名：wan3.0-video（默认）/ wan3.0-video-prime（高速版）
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The media type for the first item. Valid values: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio, file, and link
parameters.name: media_1_type

parameters.help_en: The media URL for the first item. You can specify a public HTTP or HTTPS URL, a temporary oss:// URL, or inline data in the format of data:{mime};base64,
parameters.help_zh: 素材地址（第1条）：公网 http(s) URL / oss:// 临时 URL / data:{mime};base64,... 内联数据
parameters.name: media_1_url

parameters.help_en: The media type for the second item. Valid values: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio, file, and link
parameters.name: media_2_type

parameters.help_en: The media URL for the second item. You can specify a public HTTP or HTTPS URL, a temporary oss:// URL, or inline data in the format of data:{mime};base64,
parameters.help_zh: 素材地址（第2条）：公网 http(s) URL / oss:// 临时 URL / data:{mime};base64,... 内联数据
parameters.name: media_2_url

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Valid values: adaptive (default), 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, and 9:16
parameters.name: ratio

parameters.help_en: The video duration in seconds. Valid values: an integer from 2 to 30, -1 (intelligent duration), and 0 (server default of 5 seconds)
parameters.help_zh: 视频时长（秒）：[2,30] 或 -1（智能时长）；0 = 服务端默认 5 秒
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include an audio track. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含音轨，默认 true
parameters.name: audio

parameters.help_en: The random seed. Valid values: -1 (random), an integer from 0 to 2147483647, and 0 (server default of random)
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable intelligent rewriting (prompt_extend). Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启智能改写（prompt_extend），默认 true
parameters.name: prompt_extend

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add a Model Studio watermark. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否添加百炼水印，默认 false
parameters.name: watermark

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The additional information. A value of success indicates that the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 success

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is used to query the generation result
TaskId.description_zh: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
TaskId.title_en: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
TaskId.title_zh: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
